name: Triceps Dip Machine
how_to:
Step 1: Adjust the Machine
- Set the seat height so that your upper arms are in line with the handles.
- Choose a weight that allows for proper form and controlled movement.
Step 2: Setup and Positioning
- Grip the handles firmly.
- Keep your elbows tucked in close to your body.
- Place your feet flat on the ground to stabilize your position.
Step 3: Execution
- Press the handles downward, fully extending your arms while engaging your triceps.
- Pause for a second at the bottom to maximize muscle activation.
- Slowly return to the starting position, controlling the weight as you bend your elbows.
- Repeat for the desired number of reps, keeping movements controlled and steady.
